profile_text.body:
Luma AI is a Palo Alto-based company that describes itself as a creative AI platform for video generation and image creation. The company positions its products around two video generation models, Ray and Uni, along with what it calls creative agents designed to handle end-to-end creative workflows. It describes its intended customers as agencies and brands, and offers free access to try the platform.

The company's Uni-1 model is presented as a brand intelligence tool that carries style references, character references, and visual grounding into generated assets, with the stated aim of understanding a brand as deeply as it generates content for it. Luma AI is also associated with a project called Wonder Project and Luma Launch, described as a production services company combining generative AI and traditional filmmaking.

The site's held facts list Luma AI's primary product under the video generation and editing category, noting 3D and video generation as its focus. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company in the available data.
